clauses.quote: no new subjects for negotiation may be introduced by either party without mutual consent.
clauses.notes: Mutual procedural restriction prevents unilateral introduction of new negotiation subjects.

clauses.quote: The initial proposals of both parties shall constitute the agenda, with the discussion order to be jointly agreed upon before negotiations begin on specific items.
clauses.subject_text: The initial proposals of both parties
clauses.notes: Establishes that initial proposals form the official agenda.

clauses.quote: The negotiation teams will meet in closed sessions, unless otherwise agreed upon mutually in advance.
clauses.notes: Procedural mandate for closed-door meetings.

clauses.quote: All proposals must be channeled through the negotiation teams at the table.
clauses.notes: Centralizes proposal routing through designated teams.

clauses.quote: The teams will present relevant data, exchange points of view, and make proposals and counterproposals.
clauses.notes: Outlines core functions of negotiation teams during sessions.

clauses.quote: Upon request by either party, the other shall make available for inspection its public records and data pertinent to the subject under negotiation.
clauses.notes: Reciprocal discovery duty; typically benefits union access to district data.

clauses.quote: Either party may utilize the services of consultants to assist in negotiations.
clauses.notes: Grants mutual discretion to hire outside experts during bargaining.

clauses.quote: If negotiations are scheduled during the school day, the negotiators shall be released from regular duties without loss of pay.
clauses.notes: District obligation to release and maintain pay for union negotiators on duty.

clauses.quote: all understandings must be reduced to writing, dated, and signed by both parties at the time tentative agreement is reached.
clauses.notes: Documentation requirement for tentative agreements.

clauses.quote: All such agreements achieved in process will remain tentative pending completion of an agreement on the entire package.
clauses.subject_text: All such agreements achieved in process
clauses.notes: Status declaration regarding provisional nature of partial agreements.

clauses.quote: Tentative agreement on the entire package must also be reduced to writing and signed by both parties at the time the complete tentative agreement is reached.
clauses.subject_text: Tentative agreement on the entire package
clauses.notes: Mandates written execution of the full tentative package.

clauses.quote: Such agreements shall be recommended to the Board and the Association for approval by both negotiating teams.
clauses.notes: Procedural step forwarding tentative agreements to ratification bodies.

clauses.quote: The complete agreement shall become final upon ratification by the Board and the Association.
clauses.notes: Conditional status change triggered by mutual ratification.

clauses.quote: either party may declare to the other in writing that an impasse exists and call for a mediator.
clauses.notes: Grants mutual discretion to initiate formal impasse mediation.

clauses.quote: A written request for mediation shall be considered a joint request,
clauses.notes: Legal fiction treating unilateral request as joint for procedural purposes.

clauses.quote: the other party shall join in the request.
clauses.notes: Compels the non-requesting party to formally endorse mediation.

clauses.quote: both parties shall submit the items at impasse to a mediator through the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service.
clauses.notes: Mandates mutual referral of disputed issues to a designated federal mediator.

clauses.quote: The mediator shall endeavor to assist the parties in overcoming the impasse and reaching agreement on the issues at impasse.
clauses.notes: Sets the mediator's core duty to facilitate resolution.

clauses.quote: His or her efforts shall be limited to the issues at impasse.
clauses.notes: Restricts mediator scope to specifically listed disputed items.

clauses.quote: The parties agree to cooperate with the mediator by meeting with him or her promptly and making available at his or her request any public records and data pertinent to the issues at impasse.
clauses.notes: Declarative clause functioning as mutual duty to cooperate and provide data during mediation.
